observations.why: Firm directive whose 'entirely' intensifies the instruction, but it records no settling or ratification and is not framed as an operational rule, so the lower region holds.
Directive with a total quantifier ('all') carrying commitment, but it is an instruction without performed settling, so claim rather than decision.
